text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion. I've been watching 
your practice for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how earnest the two of you were, I 
simply couldn't look away――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I felt like simply watching 
was a total waste.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Occupational habit makes me think, "If 
only I could stream this..." but I suppose 
that's poor taste.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Please keep doing your best. We have high 
hopes for your success!
